The handle name used when posting to the site '$$オカルトフォーラム$$' on the $$ＵＮ$$.
It was originally a nickname given to him by his older sister, and carries her wish that he become a strong man who could protect himself.
fixes.reason: mistranslation/addition: the Japanese says 自分を守れる (protect oneself; 自分 refers back to the man the wish is about) and names no one else; 'protect her' (the sister) was an inference from the nickname

A member of the $$香月$$ Gang, a delinquent group that had been at odds with $$勝平$$.
Captured by $$ガイゾック$$ during an evacuation with $$香月$$ and the others, $$浜本$$ was turned into a human bomb without knowing it. Trying to die in a place where he would cause no trouble to those around him, he broke down in panic, unable to bear the fear of dying alone. Held down by others who had likewise become human bombs, he screamed for help as he died in the explosion.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Hamamoto is researched as male; the old rule made the translator use they/them for a known-male character

fixes.new:
A biological terminal created by $$イオリア$$. Because aging suppression was applied, no outward change whatsoever is seen even as months and years pass.
At one time $$リボンズ$$ served $$アレハンドロ$$, then worked behind the scenes, urging the founding of $$アロウズ$$ and more, seeking to rule the humanity he looked down on.
However, the original purpose of his existence lay in having been created to promote the evolution of humanity.
Eventually, $$リボンズ$$ analyzed the $$ツインドライヴ$$ of the $$ダブルオー$$ and installed it in his own unit, the $$リボーンズガンダム$$, and fought on equal or better terms with $$刹那$$, who had awakened as a pure-blooded Innovator. In the midst of the fierce battle, $$リボンズ$$ seized one of the $$ダブルオーライザー$$'s $$ＧＮドライヴ$$s. By coincidence, he met the $$０ガンダム$$ that he himself had once piloted, and faced $$刹那$$, who had switched to the $$ガンダムエクシアリペアⅡ$$, in the final decisive battle, but was defeated and died.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Ribbons is researched as male; they/their replaced with he/his (verb agreement 'were defeated' -> 'was defeated')

fixes.new:
Cyborgs built by $$破嵐創造$$, father of $$破嵐万丈$$, for the Mars development work and, by extension, for humanity's advance into space. Though originally human, they call themselves 'beings beyond humanity' and come to fight humanity with the aim of turning all of humanity into $$メガノイド$$s.
Their leader is $$ドン・ザウサー$$, and under the close aide $$コロス$$, the commander-class 'Commanders' and the soldier 'Soldiers' work in the shadows as the operational force.
Commanders can grow huge through the power of the Macro Cells implanted in their bodies and transform into 'Megaborgs'.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Don Zauser's gender is unknown; the Japanese 側近のコロス names Koros as (the) close aide, no possessive; 'his aide' assigns a gender

fixes.new:
A system developed by $$トライア$$ to protect the ego of $$クロウ$$ from the backlash of the $$スフィア$$ '$$揺れる天秤$$' mounted on the $$リ・ブラスタ$$.
$$ＣＤＳ$$ is short for 'Coin Drop System'.
When $$クロウ$$ is about to be taken over by the strong will needed to draw out the $$揺れる天秤$$, the sound of the coins he loves rings out, in order to hold that consciousness in place below the level of awareness.
That allows $$クロウ$$ to keep hold of his ego by the barest margin while drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$.
Because real sound is used in order to value realism, actual expenses are incurred whenever the system activates. As a result, $$クロウ$$ came to bear the fate of being tied down to something other than the $$スフィア$$.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Crowe is researched as male; one repeated $$クロウ$$ token replaced by 'he' and 'the ego' by 'his ego' (defect of the old no-pronoun rule; all other tokens kept)

fixes.new:
Full name $$アイム#keyword$$ Liard.
Holder of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and the man who pilots the mobile weapon Arietis.
In the $$破界事変$$ he summoned $$ガイオウ$$, King of Destruction, to sow chaos in the world, and worked in the shadows as a staff officer of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.
He was believed killed in the battle at the South Pole late in the $$破界事変$$, but that death was a mimicry produced by his $$スフィア$$'s power.
For his own ends he supplied dimensional science to $$インサラウム$$'s $$アンブローン・ジウス$$. Most of his intent is unknown, but behind his joining of the two worlds through the $$アビス$$ late in the $$再世戦争$$ there seems to lie something beyond merely hunting other $$スフィア$$ holders.
The $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$ governs human falsehood, and its holder's words and deeds are so full of lies that his true feelings are hard to grasp. He is also half absorbed into the $$スフィア$$, and when his emotions run high he becomes unable to say anything true - that is, anything meaningful.
$$アイム#keyword$$ Liard is an alias; his real name is Hermal Argo. He was originally a researcher of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and his aptitude led to the $$スフィア$$ absorbing him.
Late in the $$再世戦争$$ he was neutralized by $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ wielding the $$スフィア$$ of the Inquisitive Goat, the natural predator of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and met his end at the hands of $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$, ruler of the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom he had been using.

A film depicting the battle 12,000 years ago between the $$堕天翅$$ tribe and those who piloted the Mythical Aquarion. Based on mythology, it is a love story themed around the love between $$アポロン$$, the reincarnation of a $$堕天翅$$ hero, and $$シルフィ$$.
Note that 'Aqueria' refers to Aquarion itself.
Though the film itself is nothing special, the theme song sung by its lead actress $$アリシア$$, who played $$シルフィ$$, has been highly acclaimed.
fixes.reason: rules: single quotes for titles/terms, not double quotes

A former soldier brimming with the Marine Corps spirit.
He is an old friend of $$ミスリル$$'s Admiral $$ボーダ$$, and also a huge fan of $$テッサ$$.
